recognition_features: Steep conical edifice with concave flanks: broad lower skirt and steeper summit
Integrated unequal radial ridges and eroded gullies, subordinate small closed summit vent
Not broad low convex shield, flat capped tuya, loose cinder fragments or regular stripe-layer cone
concept_decisions: Keep steep concave profile and small summit vent. Strip concept orderly layers if any. Build coherent full-volume main mountain, broad lower skirt with radial dissection, sharper upper profile and small depressed vent. Use uneven branching/merging flank gullies and integrated divides, not repeated radial wedges like a lampshade. Snow in actual reference obscures rock, so snow-free subdued rock palette and erosional strength artistic. Material regions irregular not stratigraphic claims. Strong height to base ratio differs materially from batch79 shield.
